title: Correct person mass
description: Essential: Student correctly computes the person's mass from given surface weight and g.

title: Newton's law application
description: Important: Student applies Newton's second law to relate scale reading, mass, acceleration, and local g'.

title: Gravity variation formula
description: Important: Student uses inverse-square law for gravity (g'/g = R²/(R+h)²) to relate g' to height.

title: Height numerical answer
description: Essential: Student arrives at the correct numerical height (h = 3R or 1.92e7 m).

title: Geostationary orbit condition
description: Important: For part (2), student sets centripetal acceleration equal to gravity at satellite altitude.

title: Orbit radius derivation
description: Important: Student correctly solves for the geostationary orbit radius (r) in terms of g, R, T.

title: Minimum rope length
description: Essential: Student states the minimum rope length is H = r - R, with correct symbolic expression.

title: Sign error in Newton's law
description: Pitfall: Student uses incorrect sign in elevator equation (e.g., F_N + mg' = ma).

title: Confusing g and g'
description: Pitfall: Student uses surface g instead of local g' in the gravity variation formula or vice versa.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student shows unit analysis or converts all quantities to consistent SI units.
